page0.text:
...Why does she want to fight so much?
I might be able to understand her convictions a little more if I find out why she wants the Holy Grail.
But can I really ask her that?
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page0:1

page1.text:
"Saber. Can I ask you something?"
"Yes. What is it, Shirou?"
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page1:1

page2.text:
"Well...there's something I forgot to ask.
You're lending me your power because you want the Holy Grail, right?
So...what is your wish for the Holy Grail?"
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page2:1

page3.text: "Why I seek the Holy Grail? Will you be satisfied if I simply tell you that I want it? The Holy Grail is an omnipotent vessel. There is no wish that cannot be granted once you obtain it. One should hardly need a reason for seeking such a thing."
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page3:1

page4.text:
"No. That's not what I'm asking.
Saber, you're dodging the question."
"...Ng. Shirou, that's..."
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page4:1

page5.text:
"I'm not asking why you're seeking it. I want to know the wish you want granted.
But if you don't want to tell me, you don't have to. Wishes aren't always something to be shared."
...
Saber closes her mouth, embarrassed.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page5:1

page6.text:
I'm not surprised.
Saber didn't form a contract with me to help me.
Masters are the only ones who can obtain the Holy Grail, so she is only here to assist with that.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page6:1

page7.text:
And that's why she's hesitant to tell me her wish. But most of all...I don't want to hear her tell me about her selfish wish.
...So I shouldn't have asked.
Besides, it's disrespectful for someone without a clear wish to ask about someone else's wish.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page7:1

page8.text:
"Shirou, are you commanding me as my Master?"
That catches me off guard.
Saber turns to look at me, her gaze as serious as her tone.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page8:1

page9.text:
"Uh...no. I'm not. I didn't mean it that way.
I was just curious. Sorry for asking such a dumb question."
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page9:1

page10.text:
"No. As a Servant, I do need to disclose my desires to my Master.
Shirou. I seek the Holy Grail to fulfill a certain obligation. I desire the Holy Grail's power to fulfill the responsibility I failed to see through to the end in my lifetime."
She looks straight at me.
I see no deceit in her eyes.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page10:1

page11.text:
"Fulfill an obligation? And when you say lifetime, do you mean before you became a Servant?"
"Yes. In all honesty, I am uncertain of my own intentions.
Perhaps I only desire to do things over."
Saber looks down quietly.
For a moment...
...she looks like a lost child seeking repentance.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page11:1

page12.text:
"O-okay. I'm actually relieved.
I was worried you were going to say something Tohsaka would say, like world domination."
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page12:1

page13.text: "Hah. Rin would be angry if she heard that. But she is not the type to say such a thing. She may use the Holy Grail for herself, but her wish would certainly not bring chaos upon world."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page13:1

page14.text:
"You think so? I still think she probably shouldn't be the one to get the Holy Grail."
I nod to myself.
All the while, Saber watches me, her expression gentle.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page14:1

page15.text:
This conversation ends here.
I should never have brought this up.
The mood between the two of us eases thanks to the mention of Tohsaka, and I decide it'd be best not to pry.
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート七日目-04:page15:1
